test_summary.test_case: params.hnsw_ef parameter accepts null value without validation in POST /collections/{collection}/points/search
test_summary.expected_behavior: Should return 400 Bad Request - null is not a valid usize type value
test_summary.actual_behavior: Returns 200 OK with search results, silently accepting null value

threat_model_reference.description: REST API framework/serde assumes validation but null values slip through

evidence.related_to_known_issues: Similar to #9373 (type mismatch) and #9418-9420 (null filter validation)

validation.contract_specification: Contract states hnsw_ef is a search parameter (integer type)
validation.api_documentation: Qdrant API docs specify hnsw_ef as an integer parameter controlling HNSW search accuracy

parameter_schema.description: HNSW search parameter controlling accuracy/performance tradeoff

defect_details.should_reject_because: null is not a valid integer value for usize type
defect_details.why_accepted: Type coercion/validation gap - null treated as 'no value' instead of invalid type
defect_details.impact: API contract violation - invalid type silently accepted without error

submission_readiness.justification: Matches BS-01 pattern - null type confusion not validated, similar to historical issues #9418-9420
